arguments.message: Hi! You can trim the emails yourself in your own settings. Open your Profile → Notifications and toggle off the types you don’t want (mentions, status changes, digests, etc.). Leave assignment notifications on if you still want to be notified when something is assigned to you. The changes take effect immediately and only affect your own account. Let me know if you need help locating the settings!
